source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
You can use the **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention)** Stratagem on this unit even if that Stratagem has already been used in the same phase. If you do so:

- that use costs 1CP less
- that use does not stop other units from being targeted by that Stratagem in the same phase

detail.trigger: target owning unit with Heroic Intervention
detail.waiver: other uses of this Stratagem this phase
